passages.excerpt_preview: W. B. Yeats wrote an introduction for the English edition.
Its short lyric prose poems repeatedly address devotion, mortality, work, nature, freedom and the relation between the finite person and an encompassing spiritual reality.
itanjali: Song Offerings is Tagore’s English selection and rendering of Bengali poems.
The English volume is not identical to the Bengali book titled Gitanjali; it draws poems from more than one Bengali collection.
